Node layers

Source: R/geom-node.R
geom_node.Rd

Layers for the node ring itself: the arc, a label, a point. They read the node table of the plot's layout and only ever add their own data – the layout stays read-only.

Usage

geom_node_arc(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  width = 0.04,
  offset = 0,
  linewidth = 0.2,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

geom_node_text(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  rotate = FALSE,
  offset = 0.1,
  repel = FALSE,
  nudge_x = 0,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = FALSE
)

geom_node_point(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stat = "identity",
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  offset = 0.02,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

Arguments

mapping, data, stat, position, show.legend, inherit.aes, na.rm, ...

Standard ggplot2::layer() arguments.

width

Width of the node arc (ribbon type) or of its gap (geom_node_text), in radius units.

offset

Distance between the node ring and the layer, in radius units.

linewidth

Border width of the node arc.

rotate

Rotate the label to follow the circle. The rotation is derived from where the coordinate actually puts the label, so it stays correct for any start or clockwise.

repel

Push overlapping labels outward along their own radius. Labels that would collide are staggered by a small radial step instead of drifting sideways, which is what a circular layout needs: the angle carries the node, so a label may only move along its own spoke. ggrepel does not help here – it resolves collisions in a rectangular space and lines the labels up flat.

nudge_x

Radial nudge applied to the label.

Value

A ggplot2 layer.

Label placement

rotate = FALSE keeps labels horizontal and flips hjust on the left half of the circle. rotate = TRUE rotates them, flipping both the angle and hjust on the left half. geom_node_text() does not take an angle aesthetic – use rotate, so the two can never disagree.

Examples

ggcircos(cor(mtcars), order = "hclust") +
    geom_node_arc() +
    geom_node_text()
